chapter: Piano influences and the New Orleans scene
title: Playing with Dixieland men and having no name for his music
summary: Longhair played with old Dixieland musicians and Dave Bartholomew's group, whom no one could label his style; he only titled songs once he recorded. He names Lee Allen and Fats Domino.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
